# Pinned dependencies for .github/scripts/deepseek_review.py.
#
# Exists for two reasons: it is the cache key `actions/setup-python` needs to cache the
# pip download (~10s a run), and it stops a review job from being the place where a new
# openai major release is discovered. Versions are the ones the workflow was last
# verified against.
